findings.evidence: Adding a second engineering route could have introduced loose or wildcard routing or a second dispatcher. The exact task-key registry rejects unknown/duplicate/conflicting/wildcard keys before any compile, and both production execution paths route through the one GovernedEngineeringTaskIngress with the shared ISSUE_AGENT registries; no parallel dispatcher exists.

The engineering.implement route could accept unbounded input or fall back to a giant provider prompt. The ingress derives the route budget from the profile capability available_input_bytes and raises PromptTaskOversizeError before any dispatch; test_non_bounded_engineering_oversize_fails_closed_with_machine_reason proves it.

Caller/Issue text could select provider, model, branch, reviewer, merge, or prompt profile. The envelope carries only task/route/profile/build identity and the compile delegates through the machine; test_caller_text_cannot_select_route_provider_model_branch_reviewer_or_merge proves caller text is data.
